2014-12-25-7.comicText:
Caption: Fortunately, Thomas Jefferson was born before modern social science.

Thomas Jefferson writes with a quill on a sheet of paper:
"We hold these truths to be statistically significant. (p<0.01)"
2014-12-25-7.voteyText: A vertical graph from 0 to 1.0 with a large label "LIES" through most of the axis. Near the bottom, tiny marks are labeled ".01" and ".05" with arrows pointing to "truth" and "megatruth."
